'''Nepoy''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Nepoy system/Legends|Nepoy system]], [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]] known for its legendary [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] fields. [[Nectarwine]] and other sugary [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverages were the planets' chief exports.
